citation.title: Standard Chartered Visa Infinite Credit Card

annual-interest-rate-and-fees.Annual Interest Rate: 27.9% per annum (minimum). If payment is not made in full by the due date, finance charges will be calculated on a daily basis at 0.076% from the respective transaction dates for all transactions to the date the payment is received.

minimum-income-requirements.Singaporean/PR Minimum Annual Income:
For Priority/Private Banking customers: 
Singapore Citizens and Permanent Residents: S$30,000 
For all other customers: S$150,000
minimum-income-requirements.Non-Singaporean Minimum Annual Income:
For Priority/Private Banking customers: 
Foreigners with Employment Passes: S$90,000 
For all other customers: S$150,000

documents-required.SG Citizens or PRs:
Apply via MyInfo and prepare the following, 
1. Copy of Passport (6 months validity), and page with address displayed (where applicable), 
2. Copy of Employment Pass, 
3. Either one of the following: utility bill, tax bill, latest bank /credit card statement, rental agreement showing your address, latest mobile phone statement, letter from employer stating current address, government-issued document stating current address

our_takes.our-take: The Visa Infinite Credit Card offers premium benefits tailored for frequent travelers and high spenders. Earn up to 3 miles per S$1 spent, with accelerated rates of 1.4 miles locally and 3 miles overseas, contingent upon a minimum spend of S$2,000 per statement cycle. Enjoy exclusive perks such as 6 complimentary visits to Priority Pass lounges globally and the convenience of earning miles when paying income taxes at a preferential processing fee of 1.9%. Additional features include comprehensive travel insurance coverage up to S$1,000,000, reinforcing its appeal to discerning travelers seeking both luxury and practicality in their credit card choice.
our_takes.good-for:
Frequent travelers aiming for substantial miles on both local and overseas expenditures.
Business owners looking to earn miles while paying taxes through a convenient facility.
Jet-setters who value luxury travel benefits like Priority Pass lounge access worldwide.
our_takes.things-to-note:
While the card offers high miles rewards, the annual fee applies after the first year. Evaluate if the benefits justify the cost.
Be mindful of the preferential 1.9% processing fee for income tax payments, which can add to your tax bill.
Although the card provides complimentary travel insurance, ensure your full fare is charged to the card before traveling to activate coverage completely.
